info.title: Deep Focus selected personal extension contracts
info.description: Not deployed. Twelve selected operations EX-01 through EX-11 and EX-17 supplement, not replace, the fourteen-operation core document. External schemas declare draft-07. Contract metadata/shape checks are not full OpenAPI conformance or authorization tests. All private responses require Cache-Control: private, no-store. Exact product policies and semantic validation remain gated.

servers.description: Logical base only; no deployed domain.

patch.description: Title/description only. Owner and expected version checked in the domain transaction.

delete.description: Soft delete with no request body. Normalize Expected-Version to VersionOnly for the shared command/receipt. Clear live links atomically, retain historical attribution. Same-key retry returns the original response.
Soft delete; preserve historical sessions, cancel pending reminder intents and clear live planning links in the transaction. No request body; Expected-Version normalizes to VersionOnly.

get.description: Owned provisioned settings; missing/failed bootstrap is not a fabricated default response. No device grants, questionnaire answers or phrases.

patch.description: Account allowlist only. Shared command target is the owned singleton ID. Does not modify a running session or grant AI processing consent.

post.description: Record a started post-focus break for an owned eligible terminal session. Server derives actualMs, validates timestamps and outcome; no focus XP or physical-rest proof. Replay retains original status/body.

get.description: Owned terminal break history ordered by endedAt DESC, id DESC. Live keyset view, not a sync snapshot.

post.description: Persist explicit reminder intent for an owned eligible task. Initial enabled=true records user intent only, not OS permission/installation/delivery. One selected device installs after permission. Replay retains original status/body.

get.description: Owned nondeleted reminder intents, including disabled/missed, by scheduledFor ASC, id ASC. Editing a sort key may move a row between live pages; deduplicate by ID and refresh after changes. Use sync for complete replication.

patch.description: Versioned intent update; does not reassign task/owner or prove OS delivery. Reconcile chosen-device installation.

delete.description: Versioned tombstone plus change-feed invalidation. Offline-device delivery cannot be remotely guaranteed cancelled. No request body; Expected-Version normalizes to VersionOnly.

get.description: Half-open [start,end), reviewed maximum range and valid IANA zone require semantic checks. Unavailable snapshot means null totals, not zero; known pending/stale snapshots expose freshness. No health/attention claim.

ExpectedVersion.name: Expected-Version
ExpectedVersion.description: Application header: exactly one base-10 positive integer, no signs/whitespace/fractions/leading zeroes, <=2147483647. Normalize to {expectedVersion:n}; absent/malformed=400, stale=409. This is not HTTP If-Match. Never hash raw header spelling.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque signed actor/endpoint/filter/sort-bound cursor; not sync/export authority.

GoalDeletion.description: Durable goal tombstone and original command receipt; not a privacy-job credential.

TaskDeletion.description: Durable task tombstone and original command receipt.

ReminderDeletion.description: Durable reminder tombstone and original command receipt; device invalidation pending reconciliation.

AccountSettings.description: Owned allowlisted preferences, not a device permission record.

Break.description: Owned recorded break with server-derived duration and explicit verification state.

BreakList.description: Owned terminal break page, max 100, null cursor at end.

Reminder.description: Owned reminder intent; enabled does not mean delivered.

ReminderList.description: Owned nondeleted intent page, max 100, null cursor at end.

AnalyticsSummary.description: Owned snapshot with explicit period, freshness and unavailable state.
